outcome: time from catheter withdrawal to delivery
cohort: 180 pregnant women (85 nulliparas and 95 multiparas) undergoing labor induction
finding: The Cervical Ripening Double Balloon catheter was associated with a shorter time to delivery in both nulliparas and multiparas, and a lower cesarean section rate in nulliparas compared to the Foley catheter.
mod_finding: This study found that use of a Cervical Ripening Double Balloon catheter (CRDB) was associated with a lower cesarean section rate in nulliparas compared to a Foley catheter.
